about: DU Cosmetic Co., Ltd. is a Korean manufacturer of colour cosmetics for the mass market. The company developed its own spout packaging (a pouch with a dispensing nozzle).

Its products are sold through major Korean value-price retail chains. The range covers lip tints, mascara, liquid eyeliner, concealer, foundation, lip & cheek products, lip glosses and plumpers, and other colour cosmetics.
